<h2>Build a surgical sjSDM CV invalidation manifest</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Build a surgical sjSDM CV invalidation manifest
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_cv_invalidation_manifest(
  data_continental_audit,
  regional_store_root = NULL,
  regional_units = base::c("eu_r001", "eu_r002"),
  regional_tier_store = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_continental_audit">data_continental_audit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Completed continental retention audit.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="regional_store_root">regional_store_root</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional paleo regional target-store root.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="regional_units">regional_units</code></td>
<td>
<p>Regional units whose partial CV state must be reset.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="regional_tier_store">regional_tier_store</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional paleo regional tier-tuning store.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with one row per target selected for invalidation.
</p>
